description:
Searches the user's job-search contacts in GigHQ — recruiters, hiring managers, referrals, and other people they are networking with.

Use this tool to:
  - Find a contact before drafting an outreach or follow-up message
  - See who the user already knows at a company before an interview or application
  - Review which contacts are stuck at a given outreach stage

Status filter values: not_contacted, reached_out, responded, in_conversation, connected, cold.
Contacts are created in the GigHQ app or via the browser extension — this MCP connection cannot create or delete them.

name.description: Filter by contact name (case-insensitive substring match).

skip.description: Number of contacts to skip for pagination.

take.description: Number of contacts to return (default 25, max 100).

name: search_contacts
